001package org.gbif.api.model.occurrence;
002
003import java.util.Collection;
004import java.util.Objects;
005import java.util.StringJoiner;
006import java.util.UUID;
007
008import jakarta.annotation.Nullable;
009import jakarta.validation.Valid;
010
011import com.fasterxml.jackson.annotation.JsonCreator;
012import com.fasterxml.jackson.annotation.JsonProperty;
013
014import com.fasterxml.jackson.databind.JsonNode;
015
016import io.swagger.v3.oas.annotations.ExternalDocumentation;
017import io.swagger.v3.oas.annotations.media.Schema;
018
019/**
020 * SQL Based downloads — experimental feature.
021 */
022@Schema(
023  description = "An occurrence download request defined in SQL.",
024  externalDocs = @ExternalDocumentation(url = "https://techdocs.gbif.org/en/data-use/api-sql-downloads")
025)
026public class SqlDownloadRequest extends DownloadRequest {
027
028  //Default download format.
029  private static final DownloadFormat DEFAULT_DOWNLOAD_FORMAT = DownloadFormat.SQL_TSV_ZIP;
030
031  @Schema(
032    description = "An SQL query defining the filter and output for the download."
033  )
034  private String sql;
035
036  public SqlDownloadRequest() {
037
038  }
039
040  /**
041   * Full constructor. Used to create instances using JSON serialization.
042   */
043  @JsonCreator
044  public SqlDownloadRequest(
045    @JsonProperty("sql") String sql,
046    @JsonProperty("creator") @Nullable String creator,
047    @JsonProperty("notificationAddresses") @Nullable Collection<String> notificationAddresses,
048    @JsonProperty("sendNotification") @Nullable Boolean sendNotification,
049    @JsonProperty("format") @Nullable DownloadFormat format,
050    @JsonProperty("type") @Nullable DownloadType type,
051    @JsonProperty("description") @Nullable String description,
052    @JsonProperty("machineDescription") @Nullable JsonNode machineDescription,
053    @JsonProperty("checklistKey") @Nullable UUID checklistKey
054    ) {
055    // Check the format is suitable for an SQL download, and check predicate formats are suitable for predicate downloads.
056    super(
057      creator,
058      notificationAddresses,
059      sendNotification == null ? Boolean.TRUE : sendNotification,
060      format == null ? DEFAULT_DOWNLOAD_FORMAT : format,
061      type == null ? DownloadType.OCCURRENCE : type,
062      description,
063      machineDescription,
064      checklistKey
065    );
066    this.sql = sql;
067  }
068
069  /**
070   *
071   * @return the sql query.
072   */
073  @Valid
074  public String getSql() {
075    return sql;
076  }
077
078  /**
079   * This parameter when present provides the SQL query for custom download
080   * @param sql
081   */
082  public void setSql(String sql) {
083    this.sql = sql;
084  }
085
086  @Override
087  public int hashCode() {
088    return Objects.hash(super.hashCode(), sql);
089  }
090
091  @Override
092  public boolean equals(Object o) {
093    if (this == o) {
094      return true;
095    }
096    if (o == null || getClass() != o.getClass()) {
097      return false;
098    }
099    if (!super.equals(o)) {
100      return false;
101    }
102    SqlDownloadRequest that = (SqlDownloadRequest) o;
103    return Objects.equals(sql, that.sql);
104  }
105
106  @Override
107  public String toString() {
108    return new StringJoiner(", ", SqlDownloadRequest.class.getSimpleName() + "[", "]")
109      .add("sql=" + sql)
110      .toString();
111  }
112}
